description:
Fetch the status and dataset items of an Actor run started by one of the data tools, for example a run that was still running when its tool call returned.

Returns the run status, the total dataset item count and the items themselves (offset by `offset`, capped by _maxItems). Running runs are long-polled for up to 60 seconds; if still running, call again with the same runId.

Apify run results are billed to your Apify account like any other run.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Present for interface uniformity with the data tools (default 0.5). Retrieving results does not start a new run, so this has no effect on cost.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return (1-1000, default 50).
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

offset.description: Number of dataset items to skip (default 0).
offset.title: Offset

runId.description: The Apify run ID returned by a data tool call.
runId.title: Run ID

name: get_run_results
